blocks.title: Key Concepts (Guide Summary)
blocks.content:

( 1 ) Impose a single tax on a single good /
service by elimination of multiple taxation

( 2 ) Eliminate

the difference in tax rates

( 3 ) Make digital procedures of tax collection

( 4 ) Reduce tax evasion and avoidance and

( 5 ) Reduce the cost of tax collection and ease

( 6 ) Reduce the burden of indirect taxes on

Types of GST :

(l)CGST and SGST/UTGST:
CGST : Central GST charged as centre's

tax.
SGST I UTGST : State GST I Union Territories GST charges as the state's tax.
( 2 ) IGST : It is the rate of OST applicable

roduced in one state and sold

d P
on goos
in another state. It ts called Integrated
Goods and Services Tax.

Enforcement of GST :
( 1 ) Set up of the GST Council :
( 1 ) OST Council determines the rate of

OST and regulate the OST procedure.
( ii ) The chairperson of GST Council is

the Finance Minister of India and
the finance ministers of states are
the members of the council.
(iii) Generally

the council meets every
three months.

( 2 ) Rates of GST : 5 different rates of OST

are determined for different types of
goods and services.
( i ) Zero GST : Certain agricultural
goods like vegetables, fruits, cereals,
education and health services have a
0 % rate of OST.
( ii ) 5 %, 12 %, 18 % and 28 % : Depending

on the type of needs they satisfy,
other goods and services are taxed
accordingly.
(iii) ,28 %

rate is imposed mostly on
entertainment and luxury goods/
services.

(iv) Compensation to states : The states
that suffer loss of revenue owing to
introduction of OST, compensation is
provided for 5 years from introduction
of OST.
( v) Goods like (a) Alcohol (b) Petroleum
products (Petrol, diesel, crude, natural
gas and Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF))
are kept outside the purview of OST.
Though they are taxed according to
the earlier rates and gradually may
be brought under OST.
Tax Credit Scheme : OST allows for input

Tax credit. OST paid by the trader at the
time of purchase of goods is · deductible from
OST payable at the time of the sale of the
same goods.
➔ For example, a trader pays OST off 15000

at the time of purchase of goods and if
f 18000 is payable as OST on sale of the
same goods, then input Tax credit will be
f (18000- 15000) = 3000.
